{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma2oa
|version1= 1.56

|game2= tkoh
|version2= 1.00

|game3= arma3
|version3= 0.50

|gr1= GUI

|eff= local

|descr= Displays structured text in 3D world. GUI layer for indicator is {{hl|2733}}.

|s1= [text, position, minDist, fadeDist] spawn [[BIS_fnc_3Dcredits]]

|p1= text: [[String]] with optional [[Structured Text]] formatting

|p2= position: [[Array]] in format [[Position]]

|p3= minDist: [[Number]] - (Optional, default 20) distance in which text is displayed

|p4= fadeDist: [[Number]] - (Optional, default is 1.5) distance in which text starts fading again

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>["<t size='2'>Hello World</t>", getPosATL helloWorld, 15, 0] spawn BIS_fnc_3Dcredits;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>["<img size='2' image='img\myImage.paa'/><br />Some text on the second line", getPosATL someObject] spawn BIS_fnc_3Dcredits;</sqf>

|seealso= [[Functions Library]]

|exec= spawn
}}
